ruleset: DockShield Baseline (aligned with CIS Docker Benchmark)

rules.title: Container runs as root user
rules.description: The final image stage has no non-root USER instruction, so the container process runs as root.
rules.remediation: Create an unprivileged user and switch to it with a USER instruction.

rules.title: Hard-coded secret in ENV/ARG
rules.description: A credential-like variable is assigned a value inside the image, exposing it to anyone who can pull or inspect the image.
rules.remediation: Remove the secret from the image; inject it at runtime via Docker/Kubernetes secrets or BuildKit --mount=type=secret.

rules.title: Unpinned or 'latest' base image
rules.description: The base image is not pinned to a specific version or digest.
rules.remediation: Pin the base image to a specific version tag or, preferably, an immutable @sha256 digest from a trusted registry.

rules.title: ADD used instead of COPY
rules.description: ADD can auto-extract archives and fetch remote URLs, which increases the attack surface; COPY is more predictable.
rules.remediation: Use COPY for local files; fetch remote content explicitly with curl/wget and verify its checksum.

rules.title: Missing HEALTHCHECK instruction
rules.description: The final image defines no HEALTHCHECK, so orchestrators cannot detect a hung or compromised service.
rules.remediation: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction so the runtime can detect unhealthy containers.
